hero.title: Welcome to Anor Avenue
hero.subtitle: Luxury stays in the heart of Tashkent

location.title: Steps from everything, hidden from the noise
location.intro: We sit in a quiet pocket of central Tashkent — close enough to walk everywhere, far enough to actually rest.

items.dining: 5 local eateries within a short walk
items.atm: ATMs and cash withdrawal points close by

kitchen.title: A kitchen big enough to feel like home
kitchen.intro: Breakfast every morning, made fresh and halal from local Uzbek ingredients delivered daily — the exact spread depends on your chosen package.

open247.title: Open 24/7
open247.desc: Use the kitchen any time. Keep your own food in the shared fridge, brew tea or coffee, heat something up — it's yours to use.

equipped.title: Fully equipped
equipped.desc: Microwave, kettle, full set of plates, cups and cutlery. Bring something from the market next door, or ask us to bring it to your room.

space.title: Bright and spacious
space.desc: Wide glass walls all around, with both an indoor and an outdoor entrance. Free drinking water always available.

vending.title: Vending machine
vending.desc: Cold drinks and snacks available any hour, paid or unpaid as you prefer.

garden.title: Like stepping into your own villa
garden.intro: A wide garden with seating, shade from the trees, and birds we feed ourselves. Greenery follows you through the corridors and into the rooms — quiet, breezy, never crowded.
garden.smokingArea: A designated smoking area is available in the garden.

items.cameras: 24/7 monitored security cameras throughout the property
items.fire: Fire extinguishers installed in every area, ceiling and wall
items.water: Hot and cold water available at all times

services.title: Everything you need, close at hand

reception.title: Reception, 24/7
reception.desc: Any issue, any hour — we're here to solve it. Free guidance on Tashkent tours, sightseeing, and getting around.

housekeeping.title: Cleaning on request
housekeeping.desc: Ask for room cleaning whenever you'd like. Towels and linens are changed and refreshed regularly.

laundry.title: Laundry & steam ironing
laundry.desc: Our staff handles your laundry, with a modern steam iron available in the hallway.

dining.title: Discounted local dining
dining.desc: We can arrange discounted meal orders from the eateries right next to the hotel.

rentACar.title: Car rental, with our referral
rentACar.desc: A car rental service is right next door — book through us for a discount.

staff.title: A team that solves problems
staff.desc: Friendly, attentive staff who treat your stay as their own responsibility.

roomFeatures.connecting: Connects to neighboring room on request — ideal for families
